name: Flying swords
look: Flying-sword formation from cultivation fantasy. Eight slim glowing spirit swords orbit the character in a ring at chest height, points outward, trailing faint cyan light.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the swords fan out from behind the character's back and spread into the ring

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the swords orbit steadily round the character, light trails behind each; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; the swords swing together to the right side, cross into a barrier and sparks burst where the blow meets them

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the swords stop, then fly off outward in every direction and vanish as streaks
